Don't let condescending Sonic purists fool you. Sonic Mania is better than the original games. The levels are bigger, flow better, and the action is more exciting. Take it from somebody who grew up with a Mega Drive and played about 2000 combined hours of the original 4 games.

Sonic Mania needs to become a blueprint for future 2D Sonic titles, and badly deserves a sequel that it will probably never get.
ragebait simulator is so cool i even ragebating at the special zones cool im not ragebaiting in normal game

Alright lets cut to the chase here. Sonic mania plus is one of best 2d platformers i`v ever played. I have soft spot for sonic 3 and knuckles. but this game in my opinion has one flaw that could be easily fixed with a follow up. more new levels and music tracks and maybe a new character. Otherwise this game is a 9.5/10 Go play it. all versions of the games are great. the mod support is great for this version though. So if you are into high speed action pixel art 2d platformers PLAY THIS DAMN GAME!

This game is excellent! It's back to what Sonic used to (and should always) have been. I've been playing Sonic games ever since they first came out back in 1991. They were great up to SonicCD. After that is where it really started to go downhill. Then it became nothing but running and looping around with hardly any enemies, no skill, and frankly no point to playing. Sonic Generations tried to make up for it and was halfway decent. But this one was done right. You can see the love that was put into it. It takes me back to being a kid again. I really hope any Sonic game that comes out after this really follows Sonic Mania's lead.

This was the return to the classic formula that all of us Sonic fans were waiting years for. I've replayed this game so many times to the point where it's not even funny, in fact I'd call it a perfect game. I love it so much that I bought it on 3 different platforms.

This game is the true Sonic 4 and even dons the retro 16-bit look with a bit of modern flare and shading, even bringing back fan favourite zones from the trilogy without making them feel stale and rehashed. The music is amazing (it's a Sonic game, we all knew it would be) with a different rendition of the zones theme in both acts.

I haven't played Sonic Superstars yet but I already know it won't live up to the expectations I have after playing Mania. I hope one day we get another game made by the same team.

You've heard the praise for this game and its all true. But I liked it enough to buy it on PS5 and Switch. You know this game did it right when the Sonic AIR community stole the Drop Dash for their game.

Now that the game is available to OWN on PC and is no longer liable to disappear if the servers go down, this is a perfect classic style Sonic game. They managed to be really creative, even with the many levels that are based on old ones. If you love retro games, and Sonic in particular, then this game is a must play. It oozes with retro authenticity, love, care, and passion in every aspect. It's ridiculously evident throughout the experience that this game was made by fans for fans.

I have at least two copies of this game which is uncommon for me. This game made me fall in love with sonic all over again, the gorgeous level designs, sprite work, music, everything is a love letter to the franchise that I someday hope to see again. In the immortal words of some anonymous wise man; "I love you b*tch, and I'm never gonna stop loving you".

I have never ever played such a atrocity the graphics make my eyes melt down to the point where I get a migraine whenever I play this game. I do not recommended this game top anyone it was impossible to run and I have a beefy pc. terrible game 10/10

This is a great game. The first time playing the game gave me a nostalgic feeling from when i first played a classic sonic game. This game is great for people that love the old school sonic games. Every thing about the game is perfect. But i wish there was more new levels. But its still nice to see old levels again. Great Job SEGA! 11/10
If you want to play a 2D Sonic game, this is a really good one to play. I enjoyed it all the way through.

I bought this game (which was on sale at the time) knowing I completely suck at it. (I couldn't even get past the second zone in classic Sonic lol) So then, I started playing. I had already heard of this game before so I knew it had the classic Sonic feel. And let me just say, it was more fun than I expected. Sure, there were a few obstacles in some zones and acts that I absolutely hate, but other than that, it's pretty cool.
Another thing you can consider is multiplayer. Most Sonic games (that I know of) are single player so this was quite interesting. So, knowing that there's multiplayer support I asked my little sister to try this game, and now she comes to me every thirty minutes asking if we could play again lmao
I'm not the type to go into gameplay stuff, so I'll just stick with what I've mentioned. Ill keep this review updated if I change my mind. In the meantime, If you want the classic Sonic feel whilst trying to not be too outdated, then definitely buy this game.

I had a lot of fun playing this game, the levels are designed in a way that will make them really fun to play and also quite difficult at times. Also the music made me bop my head to where I dropped my headset.

This title is a love letter from Sonic's proficient fans and a testament to what can happen if you occasionally step back to let fans try something with your IP.

In this case it worked very well.

The designs are charming, the levels are big and colorful, the spirit of old-fashioned Sonic adventures is here on full display.

If you grew up with Sonic you will want to grab this one.
Super classic, some great throwbacks. The levels are completely redesigned and hybrids of older ones. It's nuts. like it.

One of the best and most enjoyable 2D sonic games in the franchise. It has a lot of different mechanics, easter eggs, older stages and as well new ones. I definitely recommend it!

I still think Sonic 3 & Knuckles is my favorite classic style game in the franchise, but this game is right behind it. The only downside of it is that I wish all the levels were brand new. But when even the old levels still feel brand new, that really isn't a valid complaint. 10/10

Without a doubt the best 2D Sonic game to date. Awesome level design, incredible music, and the amount of detail that was put into this game is insane. Its so animated and colorful and their is so much respect paid to Sonic and even SEGA fans in general. My only beef with this game is that I wish there was more original levels because the original levels are fantastic especially Mirage Saloon Zone. To quote videogamedunkey its a 10/10 MASTAPEECE

What can I say about this masterpiece of a game that hasn't already been said before... It has incredible level design, outstanding music, damn near perfect physics, a HUGE modding community, and above all else, is just pure fun! This game is a must-own for any gamer. Period. I don't care if you're a hardcore fps fan, still buy this incredible game. The denuvo is still kinda bullcrap, but even though it's a pain to get it off your computer, it doesn't completely ruin the game like some people say.

Easily the greatest Sonic title made thus far. The mechanics are solid and match the classics, with every character's moves opening up many paths in each level. Even Green Hill Zone felt new and fresh here~ The graphics have a distinct 90s "pop", they're crisp and colourful. There are many, *many* classic SEGA references abound, all there to support the incredible level design. Finally, the music is, as the norm for Sonic, extremely good. I'm personally just disappointed in certain tracks like Flying Battery Zone not soundingas crisp in quality as, say Metallic Madness Zone (BTW MMZ has my favorite tracks in the game), but that is purely me nitpicking.

In short, buy this game and it's DLC. It's the best Sonic experience you'll have right now. I can't wait for the next game to ooze such quality and love.

Like the classic sonic games, this game delivers great 2D platforming and fast game play. But unlike the older sonic games, this one has beautiful art and absolutely awesome music. It is a nice difference from the regular modern sonic games.

I will not downvote this masterpiece just because of Denuvo. The game itself is amazing and near-flawless, puts you right back in the old school Sonic Gameplay. With great level design, bosses, and throwbacks, I believe the hard-working developers, and all others who put something into this, deserve 2 thumbs up for their apparent love of the franchise.

The greatness of the game outstands the Denuvo controversy, in my opinion.

It's a fun game with great music, but I can't recommend the game simply because of one thing.

Denuvo.

I really wanted to fully enjoy this game, but I can't because of that software. It doesn't affect me too much, but the underhanded move from Sega implement just makes me not want to play any of their future just out of pure caution of this tactic or the software being implemented again.

Playtime is low cause I double dipped this game - had it on Nintendo Switch as well.

It's like a classic Sonic game but modernized to like high-effort 2D pixel indie game standards. Music is incredible. I experience some degree of friction with the Sonic franchise's tendency to combine wanting to go fast with the levels punishing you for trying that without "foresight" (having played them enough before to know what's coming) but I think that's a "me" problem, Sonic fans seem to have no qualms about this.

Anyway, it's just really great. Sega basically contracted technically skilled and detail-obsessed fans to make this and I would like to see studios take this kind of gamble from time to time in the future.

For better or worse, this is a rather old-school gaming experience. It captures the original sonic vibe well and it is quite challenging. However, playing this game made me realize how antiquated old-school game design has become. Having lives and having to restart the act when you lose them all just becomes tedious (at the very least you don't have to go back to the start of the game). If I start a new act with one life, I might as well just suicide so I can continue and start off with 3. It's hard to go fast as well, there are so many enemies and traps that will guaranteed get you the first time cause you won't see em in time. It's unfair in an old-school way. I still think it's a good game that really does capture the old-school sonic feel, but in doing so I think it also kind of shows how maybe it's better to leave such game design in the past.
If you love classic sonic then you're getting exactly what you want here. Just don't expect to suddenly find this fun if you haven't enjoyed sonic before.

They put a Puyo Puyo bossfight into a Sonic game. A PUYO PUYO. BOSSFIGHT. INTO A SONIC GAME. What other reason do you need to buy this? This isn’t just peak Sonic – it’s peak Sega. And to think it wasn’t even made by Sega, just officially licensed! Shame on you, Sega. For the love of God, stop making 3D Sonic games and just stick with this formula forever!
A love letter to the Genesis era Sonic games. Classic levels and mechanics return with twists and innovations forging new ground. Great visuals, good level design, great soundtrack. 8.5/10
Still a great game after this long. Christian Whitehead and Headcannon really did well on this, with Tee Lopes providing an excellent soundtrack. Highly recommend.

This is my favorite sonic game in the franchise. It does everything right that the series needed at this point. Great level design that combines old zones with new and creative gimmics that change up the game greatly, exceleent graphics that look like it came from a Sega Saturn, Amazing music that makes me wanna dance everytime I hear it. Overall this is just a great game that deserves all the praise that it gets and I would give it a perfect 10/10.

This game has everything that made the classic Sonic games so amazing. But it doesn't stop there and adds plenty of new stuff, too: new graphics, lovely details, more zones, new characters, new enemies, cool new bosses and much much more.

Doesn't really improve on the 2D Formula and still has the awful 2D camera, I can really only recommend it if you're already a fan of 2D, if you aren't/can't get past the camera, it's not fixed here and you won't have a good time as it's still really trial and error.

If you enjoy the Sonic the Hedgehog series or good platform games in general this is a great one to get. While I cannot outright say that this is the best Sonic the Hedgehog game ever, because it is derivative of all that came before it, this is the definitive way that any remasters of the original Sonic 1-3 & Sonic CD should be carried out. I'd love to play through all of the original games with this same kind of update and treatment.

If you "get" Sonic games, you'll probably really like it.

If you don't "get" Sonic games, this game is not going to change your mind. Well, if the reason you didn't like Sonic games before was because you found them frustrating, maybe you'd find this one has that issue a little less. But besides that, it's probably not going to do much for you.

As for me, I think it finally helped me to really see what it is that I actually like about Sonic games, or at the very least that that element is present in more of them than I previously thought.

However, it also helped me realize that I don't actually like that element enough to really stick with this series anymore.

I guess Sonic is 2 Fast 4 Me. 4/10.

This is one of the best Sonic games to ever grace this planet, if not THE best. Highly replayable, stellar music and sprite work, amazing intro animation, and (should it strike your fancy) pretty moddable. Definitely made by fans, for fans.
If you like Sonic and haven't played it yet, pick it up. If you have never played a Sonic game but want to, pick it up. This was the breath of fresh air this series needed for oh-so-long.
